title: Introducing the Oren token page
summary: A home for $OREN. Explore the token’s role in Oren, find its official address, and watch the story in 36 seconds.

sections.heading: Added
items: A dedicated token page with the verified $OREN address, a Solscan link, and one-click copying.
A short film explaining holder access, member benefits, and the buyback-and-burn system we are building.
The platform-fee allocation: 50% for buybacks and burns, 20% for the team treasury, and 30% for the development team.

video.label: Oren token utility explainer, 36 seconds
video.caption: Holder benefits and automated buybacks are in development and are not active yet. The allocation applies to platform fees, not the amount you trade.
